## Teaching

I teach at the School of Languages and Cultures at the University of Queensland, with a focus on applied linguistics, corpus methods, and computational approaches to language data.

I have also taught workshops on statistics and corpus methods at universities across Germany and Australia, including:

- Computational methods for HASS researchers (UQ)
- Statistics for linguists (Leibniz Universität Hannover, Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz)
- AntConc & corpus tools (Leibniz Universität Hannover)
- Conditional inference trees in R (Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn, 2023)
- Advanced dimension-reduction methods (AcqVA Aurora Centre, UiT, 2023)

Through [LADAL](https://ladal.edu.au), I provide freely accessible online tutorials and workshops in:

- Text mining and topic modelling
- Visualisation of linguistic data
- Statistical modelling for linguists
- R programming for humanities researchers

---

## Supervision

I supervise Honours, Masters, and PhD students at UQ in areas related to corpus linguistics, computational linguistics, sociolinguistics, and applied linguistics. If you are interested in supervision, please contact me.
